name: Bequeath The Bag
hook: Hold a catastrophic 2008 penny stock across 16 years of inheritance
tagline: A dusty CRT monitor flickers inside an estate attorney office as forgotten certificates pile up on a desk. Cashing out sells the portfolio just in time for probate taxes and a sentimental family cruise. Crashing triggers a reverse stock split that leaves you inheriting exactly forty-two cents and a laminated certificate.
